design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not mention whether TIMSS plausible values were used or how they were handled.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses TIMSS data but does not provide information on whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not indicate the use of multilevel modeling or any method that accounts for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and appears to rely solely on internal validation.
